card.name: Digits and brackets in dosing tables
card.fires_on: Single digits or closing brackets in dosing tables and section cross-references, such as the last digit of a table number or the ) or ] after a section number like 2.2 or 6.1.

modes.label: Digits in dose tables
modes.description: A digit inside a run of numbers in a dosing or weight table.
modes.example: 5 mg 3 2 1 81 mg 4 2 <<2>> The prescribed daily dose of testosterone gel

modes.label: Closing bracket after section number
modes.description: A closing bracket or parenthesis ending a label such as (2.2) or (6.1) in label text.

card.plain: It fires on stray numbers and closing brackets in dose tables and section references in drug labels.
